title: During a flood
region: SYNTHETIC Kuala Lumpur / Selangor scenario; not a live incident or a verified shelter location

lines.text: For emergency help in Malaysia, call 999.
Go to higher, safer ground.
Avoid going through flooded areas; strong currents can sweep you away.
Do not drive into flooded areas. Avoid unstable bridges and roads that are always flooded.
Do not touch fallen cables or wires.
Do not drink floodwater.
If ordered to evacuate, do so immediately.

lines.text: Follow designated evacuation routes; shorter routes may be impassable.
Know your local flood risk and monitor official announcements.

title: SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE: During a flood - evacuation guidance
region: SYNTHETIC Kuala Lumpur / Selangor scenario; not a live incident or a verified shelter location

lines.text: For emergency help in Malaysia, call 999.
Upon receiving orders, evacuate immediately.
Evacuate early before the floodwaters worsen, or during the day as it is more practical and safe.
Follow the designated routes, as the shorter routes may be impassable.
Do not wander around deliberately in flooded areas either by foot or in a sampan.

title: SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE: After a flood - inspection guidance
region: SYNTHETIC Kuala Lumpur / Selangor scenario; not a live incident or a verified shelter location

lines.text: For emergency help in Malaysia, call 999.
Listen to radio announcements or wait for orders from the authorities.
Do not return home before being allowed to do so or until it is really safe to do so.
Do not immediately enter a flooded house, and beware of many hidden dangers.
Wear shoes.
Check for any damage to the walls, floors, doors and windows.
Check for any signs of poisonous and hazardous animals or insects.
Check for any broken or leaking gas pipes.
Check for any electrical wires submerged in water.
Check for any submerged electrical items.
Discards food item which has been submerged or come into contact with floodwaters, including canned food.
Report any damage to public amenities to the authorities.
